Alex McMenemy

Green candidate for U.S. Representative, District 38, Harris County, Texas · Open seat

Green Party activist; background in theatre and accounting (per Smarter.Vote). The Houston Chronicle voter guide lists him as a social justice advocate.

Alex McMenemy, 27, is from Tomball and calls himself a democratic socialist and ecosocialist. The Green Party of Texas nominated him at its 2026 convention to run for the open U.S. House seat in Texas' 38th District. He will face Republican Jon Bonck and Democrat Melissa McDonough on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.

Where McMenemy stands

Immigration / border security
Calls for abolishing U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and charging anyone who took part in its operations as terrorists.
Health care
Supports free, universal health care for all.
Cost of living / economy
Supports a $25 minimum wage and stronger unions and worker protections.
Education / parental rights
Supports free, universal higher education.
Checks and balances / role of Congress
Proposes banning congressional stock trading, overturning Citizens United, creating a right to recall any unpopular government official, and ending Super PACs and political lobbying.
Climate / energy
Supports a quick transition to clean energy and investment in a sustainable future. Says the planet should come before profits.
Housing / transportation
Supports expanding public transportation and building stronger communities to reduce crime and raise living standards.
Foreign policy
Calls for ending U.S. imperialism. Supports boycotting, divesting from and sanctioning Israel until Palestine is free.
Civil rights
Supports employment equity for people of color and disabled people, anti-discrimination protections in the workplace, medical care and other areas, and self-determination and Land Back for Indigenous communities.
